# Function `pill_editor_core::toolbox::handle_rect`

```rust
pub fn handle_rect(origin: egui::Pos2) -> egui::Rect;
```

Source: `editor\pill_editor_core\src\toolbox.rs:90`

Returns the drag handle's rectangle: the panel's top strip. It is the one
part of the panel where a press starts a drag instead of a click.
